entities.summary: Salem Al Ketbi is a renowned Emirati political analyst, researcher and opinion writer. Al Ketbi has a Ph.D. in Public Law and Political Science from the Hassan II University, Casablanca, for his thesis titled "Political and religious propaganda and leadership through the social media in the Arab World". Al Ketbi is a bedouin. Salem Al Ketbi was a authors & novelists from United Arab Emirates (b. 2000, United Arab Emirates). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
